title: CoolPeel in Ocala, FL | Lunchtime CO2 Laser | GLO Aesthetics
meta: CoolPeel in Ocala, FL is a 15–20 minute CO2 laser for fine lines, sun damage and pores with just 24–72 hours of downtime. Book a laser consultation at GLO.
answer: CoolPeel is a low-downtime CO2 laser resurfacing treatment on the Tetra platform that smooths fine lines, sun damage, mild acne scarring and rough texture. It suits busy people who want CO2 results without a week off. Sessions take 15–20 minutes, redness usually clears in 24–72 hours, and a series of 3 builds the best results.
treats_intro: CoolPeel treats fine lines and wrinkles, sun damage and age spots, mild acne scarring, and enlarged pores and rough texture. It refreshes the outermost layer of your skin.
how: CoolPeel is a protocol on the Tetra CO2 laser. It delivers very brief, low-density pulses of CO2 laser energy that treat only the outermost layer of your skin. That controlled, shallow treatment prompts your skin to shed damaged surface cells and make fresh collagen. Deeper layers are spared, so recovery takes days rather than a week or more. Because each session is superficial, improvements build over a series.
good_fit: You'd like to soften fine lines, sun spots or dullness
You want CO2 laser results with only a few days of redness
You have mild acne scarring or enlarged pores
You can commit to a series of 3 or more sessions about a month apart
not_fit: You have an active cold sore, skin infection or open wound in the treatment area
You've recently taken isotretinoin (Accutane) — ask your provider about timing
You have deeper wrinkles or significant scarring — Tetra CO2 laser skin revitalization is usually the better fit
expect_h2: What happens during a CoolPeel appointment?
expect_intro: A CoolPeel visit starts with numbing cream for comfort, then 15–20 minutes of quick laser passes. Your skin will be red at first, and the redness typically fades within 24–72 hours.

faq_rename.Can I go back to normal activity the sam: Can I go back to normal activity the same day after CoolPeel?

faq_add.a: CoolPeel is usually very tolerable. We apply a numbing cream first, and most people feel only warmth and a light prickling during the quick laser passes. Your skin may feel warm, like a mild sunburn, for a few hours afterward.

faq_add.q: What should I avoid after CoolPeel?
faq_add.a: Avoid direct sun and wear sunscreen every day while your skin recovers. Skip retinoids, exfoliants and harsh products until your provider says it's okay. Don't pick at any flaking skin. Most people are back to makeup within 24–72 hours.

faq_add.q: CoolPeel vs. Tetra CO2: which is right for me?
faq_add.a: CoolPeel suits you if you want a refresh with 24–72 hours of downtime and can do a series. Tetra CO2 is stronger and better for significant sun damage, deeper wrinkles and acne scarring, with 5–7 days of downtime. We'll help you choose at your consultation.
